item.title: Norristown teen shot and killed while walking to store, police searching for suspects
item.description: Hamid Boyd was shot and killed on Nov. 30. Police are asking for the public's help identifying the three suspects and their car.

item.title: South Jersey mayor indicted on child endangerment, abuse charges
item.description: Current Lumberton Township mayor Gina LaPlaca has been indicted on charges of endangering the welfare of a child and child abuse.

item.title: Delco residents face 19% tax hike in 2026
item.description: Delaware County residents may soon be digging deeper into their pockets again. County officials unveiled a new budget that, if approved, would raise taxes for the third consecutive year.

item.title: Former Eagle Laekin Vakalahi puts Super Bowl LIX ring up for auction
item.description: Former Eagle Laekin Vakalahi has put his 2024 Philadelphia Eagles Super Bowl LIX championship ring up for auction. The ring's current bid is at $40,000.

item.title: Camden High triumphs over Shabazz, clinches state title
item.description: Camden High School defeated Shabazz High School 27-8 on Wednesday night at Rutgers Stadium, clinching their first state title.

item.title: Philadelphia school safety officer shot 11 times ‘grateful to be alive'
item.description: A Philadelphia school safety officer is on a remarkable journey of recovery after being shot 11 times while trying to help during a road rage incident.

item.title: $57K grant to preserve Moorestown's Revolutionary War-era house
item.description: The Thomas Cowperthwaite House, built in 1742, is a significant piece of history, having witnessed the march of British and Hessian troops during the Revolutionary War.

item.title: SEPTA leases 10 train cars from Maryland to expand capacity on Regional Rail
item.description: SEPTA says it has leased 10 cars from the Maryland Area Regional Commuter Rail to expand capacity on the Regional Rail following a federally mandated inspection.SEPTA in November announced it signed a one-year agreement with the Maryland Area Regional Commuter Rail for 10 coach cars. item.title: Philadelphia gears up for World Cup: $770M economic boost expected
item.description: Philadelphia officials expect an influx of 500,000 fans, contributing to an estimated $770 million economic impact while creating 6,615 total jobs for the city.

item.title: Ocean City Council narrowly advances hotel plan for former Gillian’s Wonderland Pier
item.description: The Ocean City Council voted 4–3 to advance a proposal that could eventually transform the former Gillian’s Wonderland Pier amusement park into a large-scale beachfront hotel.
